samples.notes: The primary path separates the pruning gap, entropy insight, ordered AMP pipeline, benchmark evidence, distillation dependency, and evaluation boundaries. Secondary branches retain ablations and head-free applicability without crowding the primary path.
The path preserves the explicit confounder model, GIN/IPA intervention, cross-domain evidence, heterogeneous gains, and the distinction between a pseudo-intervention and formal causal identification.

The plan centers semantic stability as the missing mechanism, connects it to the three-module method and ablations, and retains point-estimate and qualitative-mechanism limitations as a linked boundary branch.
